subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Hit the books

options.text: To have a very long list
To feel sorry about a mistake

solution:
The correct answer is: **To study very hard**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The idiom "**Hit the books**" means to study seriously with intensity and concentration. (तीव्रता और एकाग्रता के साथ गंभीरता से अध्ययन)

 
 
• Example - *I hit the books all week so now it's time to take a break.*

 
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "**Hit the books**" is "**To study very hard**"

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
